# GitHub Actions Workflows

> **Source cut:** immutable source `dd2610502746`. At this cut the Git index for `.github/workflows/` contains only:

```text
source: dd2610502746
.github/workflows/
  README.md
  ci.yml
  docker.yml
```

This file is documentation; no workflow YAML is changed and CI behavior is unchanged. There are no `deploy.yml` or `lancedb-integration.yml` workflows at this cut.

Listing workflows is not deployment. Building and smoke-testing an image is not deployment, registry publication, or universal qualification of the application. The content below is limited to facts encoded in `.github/workflows/ci.yml` and `.github/workflows/docker.yml`.

## Workflow inventory

| Path | Workflow name | Triggers | Jobs at this cut |
|---|---|---|---|
| `.github/workflows/ci.yml` | CI | `push` to `main`; `pull_request` to `main` | `syntax-gate`, `full-app-boots`, `quickstart-install`, `quickstart`, `backend-core`, `backend-oracle`, `backend-tests`, `e2e-journey`, `frontend-typecheck` |
| `.github/workflows/docker.yml` | Docker Build | `push` to `main`; `pull_request` to `main` | `docker-build` |

Only `main` is listed. There is no `develop`, tag, schedule, `workflow_dispatch`, release, or environment trigger in either YAML.

## `ci.yml` job dependencies

Edges below are only YAML `needs:`. A job with no incoming edge does not wait for another job. All jobs are started by the same workflow trigger.

```mermaid
flowchart TB
  QI[quickstart-install 3.11 3.12 3.13] --> Q[quickstart]
  BC[backend-core] --> BT[backend-tests]
  BO[backend-oracle] --> BT
  SG[syntax-gate]
  FAB[full-app-boots]
  E2E[e2e-journey]
  FT[frontend-typecheck]
```

`quickstart` uses `if: ${{ always() }}` and fails unless `needs.quickstart-install.result` is `success`, so every matrix interpreter must pass. `backend-tests` uses `if: ${{ always() }}` and fails unless both `backend-core` and `backend-oracle` are `success`. No other job declares `needs`.

Diagram source only; this review does not claim it was rendered.

## CI job behavior

### `syntax-gate`
Python 3.11 only. In `backend/`, runs `compileall` over shipped modules, excluding environments, dependencies, data/logs/caches, archive trees, `test_archives_*`, and `scripts/dev`. It is a syntax/compile gate, not a runtime or coverage gate.

### `full-app-boots`
Python 3.11, backend requirements with pip cache. Imports `main_api_app`, starts uvicorn on `127.0.0.1:8001`, and polls `/alive` up to 30 times at 2-second intervals.

### `quickstart-install`
Matrix `python: [3.11, 3.12, 3.13]`, `fail-fast: false`, job `timeout-minutes: 20`, Node 20. Requires absent `backend/venv` and `frontend-nextjs/node_modules`; runs `make setup`; runs `scripts/ci/verify_quickstart_storage.py` with Hugging Face/Transformers offline env; verifies venv, `.env`, `node_modules`, `.env.local`, and a `SECRET_KEY=` line; boots the app from the generated env and polls `/alive`.

### `quickstart`
Aggregate gate only: no checkout or tests. Checks the whole matrix result as described above.

### `backend-core`
Python 3.11, backend requirements. Runs multiple named pytest lanes (contracts, governance/board/document/assignment/memory controls, backup/restore, workflow-route, alignment-loop) plus standalone `python -m core.memory_eval`. Most steps set `TESTING=1` and use scratch SQLite paths; the memory-eval step sets its own DB and embedding environment. Per-test timeout seats are `--timeout=300` with `--timeout-method=thread`. It is not a single monolithic full-suite invocation.

### `backend-oracle`
Python 3.11, backend requirements. Runs the ORACLE registry, mutation, replay, receipt, job-wait/recovery, and related regression pytest set. Independent of `backend-core`; both feed `backend-tests`.

### `backend-tests`
Aggregate gate only: no tests. Requires both backend lanes to be `success`.

### `e2e-journey`
Python 3.11 and Node 20. Installs backend requirements plus Playwright Chromium and frontend dependencies. Boots backend on `:8001` and frontend on `:3001`; polls both. API journey tests are gating. UI journey tests use `continue-on-error: true`; a second role-UI pytest invocation is downgraded with `|| echo` of a `::warning::` message. On `always()`, dumps both server logs and uploads `e2e-screenshots` (missing files ignored). Independent of other jobs.

### `frontend-typecheck`
Node 20, `npm install --legacy-peer-deps`. `npx tsc --noEmit --skipLibCheck` is `continue-on-error: true`. The subsequent Jest suites in this job are gating: middleware/auth, RPC failure consumers, agent information UI, graduation/retry, goal utility, deferred links, assignment source-answer, agents release surface, and documents release surface.

No jobs named `backend-test`, `frontend-build`, `backend-test-full`, `test-quality-gates`, or `build-docker` exist in this workflow.

## Supported installation matrix

Only `quickstart-install` runs an interpreter matrix: CPython 3.11, 3.12, and 3.13, with `fail-fast: false` and a 20-minute job timeout. Every other Python job pins 3.11. Node is 20 in `quickstart-install`, `e2e-journey`, and `frontend-typecheck`. This is the install matrix encoded in CI, not a claim about every supported runtime.

## Fail-fast and continue-on-error

- `quickstart-install`: matrix `fail-fast: false`; `quickstart` still requires all matrix legs to succeed.
- `e2e-journey`: UI browser step is `continue-on-error: true`; role-UI failures after the first pytest command are reduced to a warning. API journey tests are not softened.
- `frontend-typecheck`: TypeScript check is `continue-on-error: true`; Jest steps are not.
- `backend-tests` and `quickstart` use `if: ${{ always() }}` so they report a failed dependency instead of being skipped.

## Scratch database and data boundaries

| Job/step group | Boundary encoded in YAML |
|---|---|
| Most backend pytest lanes | `TESTING=1` and `DATABASE_URL=sqlite:///test_ci.db` (relative to `backend/`) |
| Governance, document export, document browser lanes | Dedicated scratch files `test_ci_governance_tier.db`, `test_ci_document_export.db`, `test_ci_document_browser_helpers.db` |
| Mini-app journey and restart controls | `sqlite:///:memory:` plus `${{ runner.temp }}` paths for `ATOM_DATA_DIR`, `LANCEDB_URI`, and `MINIAPP_ROOTFS_DIR` |
| `e2e-journey` | Absolute `sqlite:////tmp/atom_e2e.db`, deleted before backend start so both the booted backend and test process resolve the same file |
| Docker smoke | `sqlite:///smoke.db` inside the disposable `atom-smoke` container |

These are ephemeral GitHub-runner or container paths. The workflows do not connect to a production database. Steps that do not set `TESTING` rely on their own `DATABASE_URL` or on the environment generated by `make setup`; they are not evidence of production-data safety.

## `docker.yml` behavior

Single job `docker-build`, with no `needs`.

- `actions/checkout@v4`, `docker/setup-buildx-action@v3`, `docker/build-push-action@v5`.
- Context `.`; tag `atom:test`; `push: false`; `load: true`. No registry is named and nothing is pushed.
- Build args include non-production dummy values for `BYOK_ENCRYPTION_KEY` and `JWT_SECRET_KEY`, plus `NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL=http://atom-backend:8000` baked into the frontend build.
- Smoke step runs the image detached as `atom-smoke`, mapping `3000:3000` and `8000:8000`, with `DATABASE_URL=sqlite:///smoke.db`, `ENVIRONMENT=development`, and `BYPASS_RATE_LIMIT=1`.
- Polls backend `/alive` up to 45×2 seconds and frontend `/` up to 30×2 seconds, asserts `/alive` contains `alive` and the frontend returns an HTTP header, prints container logs, and removes the container.
- No compose stack, Kubernetes, registry login, or deployment step is present.

```mermaid
flowchart TB
  DB[docker-build]
```

`docker-build` has no dependency edge; the diagram is source only and was not rendered in this review.

## Policy and guarantees not encoded here

The following are not defined by these workflow files and must not be inferred from them:

- Deployment, environments, manual approvals, canary rollout, automatic rollback, `kubectl`, or registry publication.
- Branch protection, required status checks, required reviews, CODEOWNERS, or merge queue policy.
- Secret scanning, code scanning, Dependabot, provenance/SBOM, or other scanner policy.
- Prometheus/Grafana deployment or canary metrics, alerting, or observability gates.
- Wall-clock guarantees beyond explicit `timeout-minutes: 20` on `quickstart-install` and `timeout-minutes: 3` on one cache-benchmark step; pytest `--timeout` values are per-test seats.
- Pass-rate, coverage, flakiness, cache-hit, or build-speed thresholds; no such thresholds appear in these YAML files.
- Availability of any model or connector.

Branch protection, review rules, and scanner settings live in GitHub repository/organization settings or separate configuration; verify them there rather than reading them into CI YAML.

## Removed from the previous README

| Previous claim | Status at `dd2610502746` |
|---|---|
| `deploy.yml` with staging/production jobs, canary, rollback | File absent; no such jobs or secrets |
| `lancedb-integration.yml` with a LanceDB service container | File absent; no LanceDB service/health-check job |
| Jobs `backend-test`, `frontend-build`, `backend-test-full`, `test-quality-gates`, `build-docker` | Names absent; actual CI jobs are listed above |
| Fixed 15–20 minute durations, 98% pass rate, 25% coverage, <60-minute suite, cache-hit percentages | No corresponding thresholds; only explicit job/step timeouts exist |
| TQ-01 to TQ-05 enforcement via random order, JSON report, reruns, coverage shell checks | No `test-quality-gates` job, no such commands in `ci.yml` |
| `frontend-nextjs-build` and `coverage-reports` artifacts | Only `e2e-screenshots` is uploaded |
| Develop-branch and manual deploy triggers | Triggers are `main` only; no `workflow_dispatch` |

Scope check: this README documents workflow YAML only. A listed workflow is not a deployment, a local image build is not a release, and a two-endpoint smoke test is not universal application qualification.
